titulo: Elephants Have Names for Each Other 🐘 #shorts  #animalfacts #elephant
descripcion:
Elephants call each other by name — just like we do. 🐘

In 2024, scientists in Kenya recorded hundreds of calls from wild African elephants. A computer learned to guess who each call was meant for. When the recordings were played back, elephants answered and walked toward calls meant for them — and mostly ignored calls meant for someone else.

And unlike dolphins and parrots, which copy each other's sounds, elephants seem to invent their names. Something we thought only humans did.

🔎 Source: Pardo et al. 2024, Nature Ecology & Evolution — "African elephants address one another with individually specific name-like calls".

What would your elephant name sound like? 👇
